title: How Many Sources, Not Just How Many Problems: Planning the Precision of LLM Evaluations from Earlier Results
abstract: arXiv:2611.33622v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When benchmark problems share sources, such as variants of one template or tasks from one repository, an evaluation budget must fix the number of sources as well as the number of problems. We ask whether pilot data or earlier evaluation results can predict, before an evaluation is run, how much the standard deviation (SD) of the score grows when the same budget is concentrated on fewer sources. We use the classical design effect with an intraclass correlation estimated on data disjoint from those used to check the prediction. On GSM-Symbolic, 100 problems drawn as 10 templates x 10 variants have an SD of 9.2 pp against 2.7 pp from 100 templates; pilot data on 15 other questions predict the ratio as 3.49 against 3.52 measured on held-out questions (medians over 20 splits; single splits err by -13% to +16%), once the actual sampling plan is included. On SWE-bench Verified, 10 randomly selected public submissions predict the median ratio

translated_title: 不仅是问题的数量，还有来源的数量：从早期结果规划LLM评估的精度
translated_abstract: 当基准测试中的问题共享来源时（例如同一模板的变体或来自同一代码仓库的任务），评估预算必须同时固定来源的数量和问题的数量。我们探讨这样一个问题：试点数据或早期评估结果能否在正式评估运行之前，预测当相同的预算集中于更少来源时，分数标准差（SD）会增长多少。我们使用经典的设计效应（design effect）方法，其中组内相关系数在与用于检验预测的数据不相交的数据上进行估计。在GSM-Symbolic上，以10个模板×10个变体方式抽取的100个问题的标准差为9.2个百分点，而100个不同模板对应的标准差仅为2.7个百分点；在纳入实际抽样计划后，基于15个其他问题的试点数据预测出的比值为3.49，与在留出问题上实测的3.52非常接近（20次划分的中位数；单次划分的误差为-13%至+16%）。在SWE-bench Verified上，随机选取的10个公开提交预测出了中位数比值……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出利用试点数据或早期评估结果，结合经典设计效应与组内相关系数，在正式评估前预测当评估预算集中于更少来源时LLM评估分数标准差的增幅，从而事先规划评估的精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using pilot data or earlier evaluation results, combined with the classical design effect and intraclass correlation, to predict in advance how much the score standard deviation grows when an LLM evaluation budget is concentrated on fewer sources, enabling precision planning of evaluations.
